title: Causal Micro-Probes Predict Which Teacher–Student–Data Triads Distill
title_zh: 因果微型探针预测哪些教师—学生—数据三元组能够蒸馏
hook: A fixed-small-budget causal response probe may rank full-run OPD gains across unseen teacher–student–data triads even when overlap, margin, and teacher-confidence rankings reverse across model families. The predicted empirical reveal is that subtracting a matched student-as-teacher control turns early training response from a pair-specific learning-curve artifact into a transferable triad-selection signal.
abstract_draft: Selecting a teacher for on-policy distillation (OPD) is not reducible to choosing the strongest model: the same teacher can provide useful local supervision to one student–data pair and unusable supervision to another. Recent work measures student-reachable teacher knowledge, local teachability, and supervision fidelity (arxiv:2604.13016; arxiv:2605.13643; arxiv:2605.30833), but these quantities are evaluated within a pair and can reverse their rankings across model families. We propose TCR-Probe, a fixed-budget pre-run diagnostic that forks an identical student-state buffer into a candidate-teacher micro-training arm and a frozen-self-teacher control arm, then normalizes their verifier-measured outcome difference by the candidate teacher's available handoff headroom. The resulting Teacher-Causal Response R(c) is intended to estimate how much teacher-specific headroom the student can actually internalize, rather than generic early optimization progress. The proposal is falsified if, over the fixed 12-triad study, leave-one-teacher-family-out rank correlation with full-OPD gain does not exceed overlap, margin, confidence, teacher-accuracy, and naive-early-gain baselines, or if prefix-permuted teacher targets retain downstream triad-selection value. A positive result would turn expensive teacher–student–data matching into a measurable pre-run selection problem while sharply delimiting the conditions under which the score transfers.

motivation.problem_framing:
Across on-policy distillation (OPD), teacher usefulness is a property of a teacher–student–data triad, not of teacher strength alone. A student must visit prefixes on which the teacher has outcome-relevant knowledge, receive a target that remains learnable at its current capacity, and convert that local signal into final task gain. The Phase 0 literature isolates pieces of this chain: openreview:TteFp6TLUA questions whether a frozen teacher is learnable at student states, arxiv:2604.13016 studies thinking-pattern overlap and recoverable teacher knowledge, and arxiv:2605.13643 plus arxiv:2605.30833 diagnose position-dependent teachability and supervision-fidelity decay.

The unresolved bottleneck is prospective transport: none of these within-pair diagnostics establishes a score that can be computed before a full OPD run and used without recalibration across unseen teacher families, student capacities, and data distributions. Raw early gain is also insufficient because it mixes teacher-specific transfer with generic adaptation to the probe buffer. TCR-Probe reframes distillability as a matched functional response: compare identical micro-training arms that differ only in whether targets come from the candidate teacher or the frozen student, then divide the excess response by verifier-measured teacher headroom. This makes the load-bearing question explicit—whether the fraction of available teacher advantage that becomes student improvement is stable enough to rank triads.
motivation.why_now: The gap is timely because several 2026 studies now expose the ingredients needed for a controlled prospective measurement: arxiv:2604.13016 operationalizes student-reachable teacher knowledge, arxiv:2605.13643 identifies local teachability collapse, arxiv:2605.30833 supplies verifier-based handoff and fidelity measurements, and arxiv:2606.09471 warns that low KL agreement can be misleading on degraded prefixes. At the same time, open-weight Qwen3 and DeepSeek-R1-Distill models, public DAPO-Math-17K and MATH data, and exact-answer verifiers make matched micro-training arms reproducible without paid APIs. What is newly possible is not another post hoc correlational proxy, but a controlled TEACH-versus-SELF intervention whose score can be tested unchanged under held-out teacher-family and data shifts.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: openreview:TteFp6TLUA examined whether a frozen stronger teacher remains learnable on student-visited states when teacher and student capacities differ.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: It did not construct a matched TEACH-versus-SELF micro-training response or test whether that response ranks full-run gains across unseen triads.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Its analysis lacked a counterfactual control that separates teacher-specific transfer from generic short-run student adaptation.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: arxiv:2604.13016 measured thinking-pattern overlap, teacher new knowledge, and gap recovery in controlled within-family OPD comparisons.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: It did not turn those observations into an unrefit prospective score validated under teacher-family, capacity-ratio, and data-distribution holdouts.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: It lacked an intervention-based estimand that normalizes realized student response by the teacher headroom available on the same student-state buffer.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: arxiv:2605.13643 used student-reachable teacher margin to identify where supervision should fade along a reasoning trajectory.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: It did not measure whole-triad distillability before training or compare candidate teachers through matched micro-training arms.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Its measurement was designed for position-wise control inside one run rather than transportable triad-level selection.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: arxiv:2605.30833 diagnosed supervision-fidelity decay using teacher confidence and prefix-handoff completion and used lookahead reward to steer training.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: It did not isolate excess learning caused by a candidate teacher over a frozen-self control or validate that quantity against cross-triad final gain.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Its signals measure target quality and local corrective opportunity, but not the student's causal functional response to consuming that opportunity.

motivation.what_changes_when_gap_closes: A validated response score would let researchers reject unpromising teacher–student–data triads before committing to full OPD and would make teacher choice an auditable selection decision rather than a strength heuristic. It would also connect the local-teachability findings of arxiv:2604.13016, arxiv:2605.13643, and arxiv:2605.30833 to a stronger empirical statement: under stated transport conditions, normalized teacher-specific micro-response predicts which triads convert local headroom into final exact-answer gain. Conversely, failure would show that distillability is too path-dependent for a fixed small-budget surrogate, redirecting effort toward adaptive within-run diagnostics.

core_claim: Across unseen teacher–student–data triads, the matched TEACH-minus-SELF fraction of verifier-measured teacher headroom is a more transferable predictor of full-run OPD gain than static overlap, margin, confidence, teacher accuracy, or uncorrected early gain.

sub_claims.statement: Matched SELF control removes the component of short-run improvement attributable to generic adaptation to the probe buffer and optimizer.
sub_claims.supports_which_aspect: Isolation of teacher-specific functional response rather than pair-specific learning-curve speed.

sub_claims.statement: Headroom normalization separates a student's conversion efficiency from the absolute amount of outcome-relevant advantage exposed by a teacher.
sub_claims.supports_which_aspect: Comparability across teachers, student capacities, and data distributions with different available gains.

sub_claims.statement: If the normalized response is transportable, its unrefit ordering remains predictive under leave-one-teacher-family-out evaluation and yields lower top-three selection regret.
sub_claims.supports_which_aspect: Prospective triad selection beyond within-pair post hoc explanation.

key_equations.description: Verifier-measured teacher handoff headroom on the frozen initial-student prefix buffer Bc.
key_equations.description_zh: 在冻结的初始学生前缀缓冲区 Bc 上，用 verifier 衡量教师相对初始学生的可用 handoff headroom。

key_equations.description: Fixed-budget outcome change of each matched micro-training arm on the same evaluation slice.
key_equations.description_zh: 两个匹配微训练分支在同一评估切片上的固定预算结果变化。

key_equations.description: Teacher-Causal Response: excess micro-training gain per unit of verified teacher headroom.
key_equations.description_zh: Teacher-Causal Response：每单位已验证教师 headroom 所产生的教师特异性微训练增益。

key_equations.description: Leave-one-teacher-family-out rank agreement between the unrefit probe score and full-OPD gain.
key_equations.description_zh: 在留出一个教师家族时，未经重新拟合的 probe 分数与完整 OPD 增益之间的排序一致性。

method_flow.high_level_pipeline: For each candidate teacher–student–data triad c, freeze the initial student and collect a shared buffer Bc of student-generated prefixes plus a held-out evaluation slice. Measure how much verifier-scored outcome headroom the candidate teacher exposes on those same prefixes. Fork the identical student checkpoint and buffer into matched TEACH and SELF micro-training arms, differing only in whether cached targets come from the candidate teacher or the frozen initial student. Convert the arms' excess outcome response into the normalized score R(c), then use that score without refitting to rank triads under teacher-family and data holdouts. The score survives only if it predicts full-OPD gain better than the named static and naive-early-gain baselines and loses that value when teacher targets are prefix-permuted.

steps.title: Freeze the triad and build matched states
steps.what_changes: For triad c, freeze the initial student checkpoint θ0, sample student rollouts from the named data source, and materialize one prefix buffer Bc plus a disjoint fixed evaluation slice Ec that every probe arm reuses.
steps.why_this_step: Holding states, examples, and initialization fixed prevents teacher comparisons from inheriting different rollout distributions before the causal contrast is formed.
steps.input: Candidate teacher Tc, initial student θ0, and public task data Dc.
steps.output: Shared student-state buffer Bc and evaluation slice Ec.

steps.title: Measure available teacher headroom
steps.what_changes: On each prefix in Bc, obtain candidate-teacher and frozen-student handoff completions, score both with the task verifier V, and average their outcome difference to compute Hc.
steps.why_this_step: The same raw response should mean different things when a teacher exposes little versus substantial outcome-relevant advantage; Hc supplies that denominator.
steps.input: Bc, Tc, θ0, and the exact-answer verifier V.
steps.output: Verified teacher handoff headroom Hc and cached target distributions.

steps.title: Run the matched TEACH and SELF probes
steps.what_changes: Fork θ0 into two arms with identical Bc, token count, optimizer, sampling marginals, and probe compute; train TEACH on Tc's cached target distributions and SELF on targets cached from the frozen θ0.
steps.why_this_step: The SELF arm estimates generic short-run adaptation, leaving target source as the operative difference between arms.
steps.input: θ0, Bc, and matched teacher/self target caches.

steps.title: Compute normalized excess response
steps.what_changes: Evaluate both probe checkpoints on Ec, subtract each outcome from the frozen-student outcome, take ΔcTEACH minus ΔcSELF, and divide by Hc to form R(c), recording Hc separately rather than silently clipping low-headroom triads.
steps.why_this_step: The numerator removes generic early gain while the denominator asks what fraction of available teacher advantage was internalized; surfacing low Hc preserves the estimand's boundary instead of hiding it.
steps.input: θcTEACH, θcSELF, θ0, Ec, and Hc.
steps.output: Teacher-Causal Response R(c) with its headroom diagnostic.

steps.title: Rank triads without recalibration
steps.what_changes: Apply the same R(c) definition to every triad and evaluate its ordering against fixed-5M-token full-OPD exact-answer gains under leave-one-teacher-family-out and data-distribution holdouts.
steps.why_this_step: Cross-holdout ranking, rather than within-family fit, is the required evidence that the response functions as a prospective triad-selection signal.
steps.input: Per-triad R(c) values and locked full-OPD gains.
steps.output: Spearman rank correlation and top-three selection regret for the unchanged score.

steps.title: Break the teacher–prefix alignment
steps.what_changes: Construct the locked placebo TEACH arm by permuting cached candidate-teacher target distributions across different prefixes within Bc while holding target marginals and all probe resources fixed, then recompute the response-based triad ordering.
steps.why_this_step: If selection value survives after teacher targets no longer correspond to their prefixes, R is tracking a generic learning-curve or target-marginal artifact rather than teacher-causal headroom conversion.
steps.input: Bc and the unchanged candidate-teacher target cache.
steps.output: Placebo response score and its downstream full-OPD selection value.

method_flow.design_reasoning_echo: The estimand is the fixed-budget outcome gain caused by replacing a frozen-self target source with candidate-teacher targets on the same initial student states, normalized by verifier-measured teacher handoff headroom. Its load-bearing premises are that Bc represents the student's early OPD state distribution, the exact-answer verifier preserves the relevant outcome ordering, matched arms isolate target-source effects, and the resulting conversion fraction is transportable across the held-out triads; that last premise is untested and is the falsification target. The naive alternative—use TEACH-arm early gain directly—confounds teacher-specific transfer with generic adaptation and favors triads with larger raw headroom, so SELF subtraction and Hc normalization are both necessary. Although matched-control estimation is a standard causal-design tool, the domain-specific object is unusual: treatment is a cached teacher target distribution applied on student-generated prefixes, exposure varies with reachable teacher headroom, and validity requires prefix-aligned supervision plus transfer of an unrefit ranking across teacher families. The method therefore claims an empirical diagnostic, not an identification theorem or a guarantee of downstream gain.

plain_motivation_en:
In on-policy distillation (OPD), a useful teacher is not simply the strongest model. Whether a teacher helps depends on the particular teacher, student, and data combination. The student needs to visit prefixes where the teacher has knowledge relevant to the outcome, receive a target it can learn at its current capability, and turn that local signal into a final task improvement. Existing work separately studies whether a frozen teacher is learnable at student states, overlap in reasoning patterns and recoverable teacher knowledge, position-dependent teachability, and decay in supervision fidelity.

The missing question is whether a score can be computed before a full OPD run and then used, without recalibration, across unseen teacher families, student capacities, and data distributions. Raw early improvement does not answer this because it combines transfer specific to the teacher with the student's general adaptation to the probe buffer. TCR-Probe compares two otherwise identical short training arms: one uses targets from a candidate teacher and the other uses targets from the frozen student itself. It divides the extra response of the teacher arm by the teacher headroom measured by a verifier. The key question is whether the resulting fraction of available teacher advantage that becomes student improvement is stable enough to rank triads.

This measurement is timely because recent 2026 studies provide the needed pieces: student-reachable teacher knowledge, local teachability collapse, verifier-based handoff and fidelity measurements, and the warning that low Kullback–Leibler (KL) agreement can be misleading on degraded prefixes. Open-weight Qwen3 and DeepSeek-R1-Distill models, public DAPO-Math-17K and MATH data, and exact-answer verifiers also allow reproducible matched micro-training arms without paid application programming interfaces (APIs). The new possibility is a controlled TEACH-versus-SELF intervention whose unchanged score can be tested under held-out teacher-family and data shifts, rather than another after-the-fact correlation.

Earlier work did not make this step. openreview:TteFp6TLUA examined whether a stronger frozen teacher remains learnable on student-visited states when capacities differ, but did not build a matched TEACH-versus-SELF response or test whether it ranks full-run gains across unseen triads; it lacked a control that separates teacher-specific transfer from general short-run adaptation. arxiv:2604.13016 measured reasoning-pattern overlap, teacher new knowledge, and gap recovery within controlled model families, but did not create an unrefit prospective score for teacher-family, capacity-ratio, and data-distribution holdouts; it lacked an intervention-based quantity that normalizes realized student response by teacher headroom on the same student-state buffer. arxiv:2605.13643 used student-reachable teacher margin to decide where supervision should fade along a reasoning trajectory, but did not measure whole-triad distillability before training or compare teachers with matched micro-training arms; its measurement was for position-wise control inside one run rather than triad-level selection that transfers. arxiv:2605.30833 diagnosed supervision-fidelity decay from teacher confidence and prefix-handoff completion and used lookahead reward to steer training, but did not isolate a candidate teacher's extra learning over a frozen-self control or validate it against final gain across triads; its signals describe target quality and local opportunity, not the student's causal response to using that opportunity.

If the response score is validated, researchers could reject unpromising teacher–student–data triads before full OPD and make teacher selection an auditable decision rather than a strength heuristic. It would connect local teachability findings to the stronger claim that, under stated transport conditions, normalized teacher-specific micro-response predicts which triads turn local headroom into final exact-answer improvement. If it fails, that would show distillability is too dependent on the training path for a fixed, small-budget substitute and would redirect work toward adaptive diagnostics during training.
plain_motivation_zh:
在 on-policy distillation (OPD) 中，有用的教师并不只是最强的模型。教师是否有帮助，取决于具体的教师、学生和数据三元组。学生必须访问到教师掌握且与结果相关的前缀，收到以当前能力仍可学习的 target，并把这个局部信号转化为最终任务提升。已有工作分别研究了冻结教师在学生状态上是否可学习、推理模式重叠与可恢复的教师知识、位置相关的可教性，以及监督 fidelity 的衰减。

尚未解决的问题是：能否在完整 OPD run 之前计算一个分数，并且不经重新校准就用于未见过的教师家族、学生能力和数据分布。原始早期提升无法回答这个问题，因为它把教师特异的迁移与学生对 probe buffer 的一般适应混在了一起。TCR-Probe 比较两个其余条件相同的短训练分支：一个使用候选教师的 target，另一个使用冻结学生自身的 target。它用 verifier 测得的教师 headroom 去归一化教师分支的额外响应。核心问题是：可用教师优势中真正转化为学生提升的比例，是否足够稳定，能够为三元组排序。

现在进行这种测量是及时的，因为 2026 年的研究已经提供了所需部件：学生可达的教师知识、局部可教性的崩塌、基于 verifier 的 handoff 和 fidelity 测量，以及低 Kullback–Leibler (KL) agreement 在退化前缀上可能误导的警告。同时，开放权重的 Qwen3 和 DeepSeek-R1-Distill 模型、公开的 DAPO-Math-17K 和 MATH 数据，以及 exact-answer verifier，使得无需付费 API 也可复现匹配的微训练分支。新近可行的不是又一个事后相关 proxy，而是受控的 TEACH-versus-SELF intervention：其分数保持不变，并在留出的教师家族和数据变化下接受测试。

先前工作没有完成这一步。openreview:TteFp6TLUA 考察了当能力不同时，较强的冻结教师在学生访问的状态上是否仍可学习，但没有构造匹配的 TEACH-versus-SELF 响应，也没有检验它是否能在未见三元组间为完整 run 的增益排序；它缺少一个能将教师特异迁移与一般短期适应分离的对照。arxiv:2604.13016 在受控模型家族内测量了推理模式重叠、教师新增知识和 gap recovery，但没有形成未经重新拟合、可在教师家族、能力比例和数据分布留出条件下验证的前瞻分数；它缺少一个基于 intervention 的量，能用同一学生状态 buffer 上的教师 headroom 归一化实际学生响应。arxiv:2605.13643 用学生可达的教师 margin 判断推理轨迹中监督应在何处减弱，但没有在训练前测量整个三元组的可蒸馏性，也没有通过匹配的微训练分支比较候选教师；它的测量用于单次 run 内的位置控制，而非可迁移的三元组级选择。arxiv:2605.30833 用教师 confidence 和 prefix-handoff completion 诊断监督 fidelity 衰减，并用 lookahead reward 引导训练，但没有分离候选教师相对冻结自身对照带来的额外学习，也没有针对跨三元组最终增益验证该量；其信号描述 target 质量与局部纠正机会，而非学生使用该机会后的因果响应。

如果该响应分数得到验证，研究者可在投入完整 OPD 前排除没有前景的教师—学生—数据三元组，并将教师选择变成可审计的决策，而不再依赖强度启发式。它会把局部可教性的发现连接到更强的经验结论：在已说明的 transport 条件下，经过归一化的教师特异微响应能够预测哪些三元组会把局部 headroom 转化为最终 exact-answer 提升。如果失败，则说明可蒸馏性过度依赖训练路径，固定的小预算替代指标无效，后续工作应转向训练过程中的自适应诊断。

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: For triad c, freeze the initial student checkpoint θ0. Sample student rollouts from the named data source, then create one prefix buffer Bc and a separate fixed evaluation slice Ec that every probe arm reuses.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: Keeping the states, examples, and initialization fixed means teacher comparisons do not start from different rollout distributions before the causal comparison.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: For every prefix in Bc, get handoff completions from the candidate teacher and frozen student. Score both with the task verifier V and average the outcome difference to compute Hc.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: The same raw response has different meaning when a teacher offers little versus substantial outcome-relevant advantage. Hc provides the denominator for that difference.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Copy θ0 into two arms with the same Bc, token count, optimizer, sampling marginals, and probe compute. Train TEACH on cached target distributions from Tc and SELF on targets cached from frozen θ0.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: The SELF arm measures general short-run adaptation, so the source of the targets is the active difference between the two arms.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Evaluate both probe checkpoints on Ec. Subtract the frozen-student outcome from each, subtract ΔcSELF from ΔcTEACH, and divide by Hc to form R(c). Record Hc separately instead of silently clipping triads with low headroom.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: The numerator removes general early gain. The denominator asks what fraction of available teacher advantage became student improvement. Reporting low Hc keeps the boundary of the quantity visible.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Use the same R(c) definition for every triad and compare its ordering with fixed-5M-token full-OPD exact-answer gains under leave-one-teacher-family-out and data-distribution holdouts.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: Ranking across holdouts, rather than fitting within one family, is the needed evidence that the response can select triads before training.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Make the locked placebo TEACH arm by permuting cached candidate-teacher target distributions across different prefixes within Bc. Keep target marginals and all probe resources fixed, then recompute the response-based triad ordering.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: If selection value remains when teacher targets no longer match their prefixes, R is following a general learning-curve or target-marginal artifact instead of teacher-caused conversion of headroom.

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 对三元组 c，冻结初始学生 checkpoint θ0。从指定数据源采样学生 rollouts，然后建立一个前缀 buffer Bc 和一个独立、固定的评估切片 Ec，所有 probe 分支都复用它们。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 固定状态、样本和初始化后，教师比较在形成因果对比前不会继承不同的 rollout 分布。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 对 Bc 中每个前缀，取得候选教师和冻结学生的 handoff completions。用任务 verifier V 为两者打分，并对结果差异取平均以计算 Hc。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 当教师提供的与结果相关优势很少或很多时，相同的原始响应含义不同。Hc 为这种差异提供分母。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 将 θ0 复制为两个分支，并让它们使用相同的 Bc、token 数、optimizer、sampling marginals 和 probe compute。TEACH 在来自 Tc 的缓存 target distributions 上训练，SELF 在来自冻结 θ0 的缓存 targets 上训练。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: SELF 分支估计一般的短期适应，因此两个分支之间真正起作用的差异是 target 的来源。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 在 Ec 上评估两个 probe checkpoint。分别减去冻结学生的结果，再用 ΔcTEACH 减去 ΔcSELF，并除以 Hc 得到 R(c)。单独记录 Hc，不要静默截断 headroom 较低的三元组。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 分子去除了通用早期增益；分母考察可用教师优势中有多少转化为学生提升。报告低 Hc 能保留该量的适用边界。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 对每个三元组应用相同的 R(c) 定义，并在 leave-one-teacher-family-out 和数据分布留出条件下，将其排序与固定 5M-token 完整 OPD 的 exact-answer 增益比较。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 跨留出条件的排序，而不是在单一家族内拟合，是该响应可在训练前用于选择三元组所需的证据。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 构造锁定的 placebo TEACH 分支：在 Bc 内将缓存的候选教师 target distributions 置换到不同前缀上。固定 target marginals 和全部 probe resources，然后重新计算基于响应的三元组排序。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 如果教师 target 不再对应其前缀后选择价值仍保留，R 追踪的就是一般 learning-curve 或 target-marginal artifact，而不是教师导致的 headroom 转化。

plain_method_modules_en.purpose_oneline: Background: freeze shared student states and establish the available verifier-measured teacher headroom.
Measure teacher-specific short-training response with matched TEACH and SELF arms, then normalize it by available headroom.
Test whether the unchanged score ranks held-out triads and whether that value depends on teacher–prefix alignment.

plain_method_modules_zh.purpose_oneline: 背景：冻结共享的学生状态，并建立 verifier 测得的可用教师 headroom。
用匹配的 TEACH 和 SELF 分支测量教师特异的短训练响应，再按可用 headroom 归一化。
检验不变分数是否能为留出的三元组排序，以及该价值是否依赖教师—前缀对齐。

falsification_prediction: Build 12 triads from Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B students; Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B teachers; and DAPO-Math-17K versus the MATH training split, then measure the probe and the 5-million-token full-OPD exact-answer gain on MATH-500 and AIME 2024. If the idea works, leave-one-teacher-family-out Spearman rho between Teacher-Causal Response R(c) and final OPD gain stays positive and exceeds the corresponding rho for top-k overlap, local teacher margin, peak confidence, teacher accuracy, and naive early gain; selecting the top three triads by R also lowers final-gain regret relative to those baselines. The ONE load-bearing variable is R(c), the matched TEACH-minus-SELF fraction of verifier-measured teacher headroom. As a non-identity negative-control intervention on that response, keep the candidate teacher, target marginals, Bc, token count, optimizer, and probe compute fixed but randomly permute its cached target distributions across different prefixes within Bc before training the placebo TEACH arm; triads selected by the resulting placebo R should return to random-selection downstream full-OPD gain, otherwise the claimed teacher-causal interpretation is falsified.
compute_budget: 72 80GB-GPU-days for 12 two-arm probes, 12 fixed-5M-token full OPD runs, decoding, two seeds, and one rerun margin; 0 USD API cost because all named models and verifiers are open-weight/local. With 8–16 concurrent GPUs this is tight but feasible and the first 12 probe/full-run pairs provide an early kill decision before expanding seeds.
what_step_was_missed: It would have needed to fork each initial student-state buffer into candidate-teacher and frozen-self-teacher micro-training arms, normalize their outcome difference by verified teacher handoff headroom, and test that resulting score without recalibration on held-out teacher families and data distributions.

compute.rationale: GPU line ≈ 72 vs 8 GPU-day (900%) → infeasible. Overall (worse line) → infeasible.

data.rationale: All required artifacts—Qwen3 and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen checkpoints, DAPO-Math-17K, MATH, MATH-500, AIME 2024, and exact-answer verifiers—are public and can be run locally.

theoretical.rationale: The contribution is an empirical matched diagnostic and transport test rather than a theorem, so no separate theoretical deliverable is required.

engineering.rationale: The implementation uses standard OPD components, but reproducibly caching prefix-aligned teacher and self targets and orchestrating 24 probe arms plus 12 full runs is a substantial systems burden.

falsification.rationale: The rank metrics, exact-answer outcomes, held-out teacher-family split, and prefix-permutation intervention are fully specified and implementable with the named open-weight tooling, although executing the full test exceeds the stated compute envelope.

differentiation_from_lit.delta: That work asks whether a frozen teacher is learnable on student-visited states within a capacity-gap setting, whereas this candidate constructs a matched functional-response measurement and tests whether its triad ordering predicts held-out-family full-OPD gain; the prior-method comparison is an abstract-only inference because its full text was unavailable.

It measures thinking-pattern overlap and teacher new knowledge in controlled within-family comparisons and reports gap recovery after full training; this candidate instead estimates pre-run excess outcome response over a frozen-self control and requires the same unrefit score to rank gains under teacher-family, capacity-ratio, and data holdouts.

It uses student-reachable teacher margin to find a trajectory-specific suffix release point, while this candidate leaves every token and the OPD objective untouched and measures whether a whole-triad causal micro-response transfers to unseen combinations.

It defines supervision fidelity from teacher peak confidence and prefix-handoff completion within a fixed pair and uses lookahead reward to steer tokens; this candidate uses verified handoff outcomes only as a normalization oracle and validates an independent matched training-response score against cross-triad full-run gain.

reviewer_concerns_and_responses.attack: Paper-pointed threat: arxiv:2605.12051v1 (collision_hits). Learning plug-in surrogate endpoints for randomized experiments directly formalizes the high-level claim that a short-term post-treatment surrogate is valuable when it predicts the result that would be obtained on an expensive real outcome, and it learns surrogates by effect predictiveness. That result prevents this candidate from claiming the general short-probe-to-long-outcome principle as novel, but it does not supply the OPD-specific matched TEACH-versus-SELF micro-training intervention, student-state construction, handoff normalization, or triad-held-out validation on which this candidate's mechanism depends.
reviewer_concerns_and_responses.response: The defense is deliberately narrow: the core_claim does not claim novelty for the general surrogate-endpoint principle, and method_flow.steps S1–S4 specify the OPD-specific matched TEACH-versus-SELF intervention, student-state buffer, and handoff-headroom normalization. Consistent with the Phase 3.2 non-blocking verdict, differentiation therefore rests on the operational estimand and held-out triad validation, not on the broad idea that a short outcome can predict a long one.

reviewer_concerns_and_responses.attack: Un-retrieved mechanism family flagged by the audit (parametric knowledge, not in the retrieved pool): Learning-curve extrapolation / early-training performance prediction; scoop-check the phrases "learning curve extrapolation" and "early training performance prediction" before treating early micro-training response as a new predictor family. — novelty vs this family is UNVERIFIED; run a targeted scoop-check on that vocabulary before investing.
reviewer_concerns_and_responses.response: A targeted scoop-check must establish that learning-curve extrapolation and early-training prediction methods do not already combine prefix-matched TEACH-versus-SELF intervention, verifier-headroom normalization, and unchanged cross-teacher-family triad ranking. If that combination or an equivalent estimand already exists, the claimed predictor-family delta does not survive and the proposal must be reframed rather than defended lexically.

domain_landscape.position_note: The OPD corpus is dominated by heterogeneous decomposition (18/36 on-topic papers), whereas this candidate uses the mid-frequency controlled-diagnostic pattern (7/36) as a stand-alone triad-selection measurement rather than another token-, position-, or trajectory-specific treatment rule.
